implementation_summary: New checkAuditAddress(url, { timeoutMs?, netDeps? }) in packages/core/src/audit/crawl/reachability.ts. It calls safeGet without allowPrivate, so resolvePublic checks every hop and the connection is pinned to the checked address (ADR 0031). Private, loopback and link-local hosts and redirect hops to them return ERR_PRIVATE_ADDRESS with no request sent. One deadline covers the whole check (default AUDIT_ADDRESS_TIMEOUT_MS = 10000, the spider's per-page navLimits): NetDeps lookup and connect are wrapped so each is cut to the time left and fails as a timeout past the deadline. A final status above 0 and below 400 returns { ok: true, finalUrl, status }. A 2xx cut at the 64 KB byte cap counts as reachable, with the final URL taken from the last request. Every other outcome (DNS failure, timeout, refused connection, 400 or above, too many redirects, non-http(s) or malformed URL) returns ERR_UNREACHABLE with a short message for people and no internals. preflight.ts and safe-net.ts are not changed.

risks: A 3xx cut at the byte cap is treated as unreachable, because safeGet returns too-large before reading Location, so the redirect was not followed. Only a cut 2xx counts as reachable; this is narrower than 'below 400' for that rare case.
Default timeout is 10 s (the spider's per-page limit); navigate() defaults to 15 s. Confirm which one is 'the existing page timeout'.
The redirect limit is safeGet's default of 5 and callers cannot change it.
No User-Agent is sent; sites that block requests without one may show as unreachable.
After the deadline, a lookup or connect that is still pending is not cancelled; it is ignored, and the default connect has its own timeout capped to the time left.
handoff: Import checkAuditAddress from packages/core/src/audit/crawl/reachability.ts in the audit start route (runner) before starting the crawl. On { ok: false }, return code (ERR_PRIVATE_ADDRESS | ERR_UNREACHABLE) and reason in the project's error format; reason is safe to show to people. On ok, use finalUrl as the crawl start. Pass netDeps only in tests. Not exported from the core package index yet.
